##: rDownloader in the Scoop bucket degoya/scoop-rdownloader (RD-180-06). Rendered from packaging/scoop/rdownloader.json.in in degoya/rDownloader by scripts/package-managers.sh and replaced by the release workflow with every release: change the template, not this file.
description: Local-first download manager with a web interface
notes: Start the service with `start-rdownloader` or the Start menu entry, then open http://127.0.0.1:8710 for the setup wizard.
The launchers run it in the app folder: the database and the installed plugins are kept in $persist_dir\data, the default download folder in $persist_dir\downloads, and updates keep both.
Stop it with `stop-rdownloader` (and `stop-capture`) before `scoop update rdownloader`.
